limitations: 16MP canvas and 4MP retouch/solve region, including the combined source/destination span. Larger work fails explicitly.
Ordinary RGB raster image target only. Smart Object editing, mask/alpha-channel retouching and Pattern Patch remain open.
Patch diffusion, structure/color adaptation, Red Eye detection and all synthesis are native approximations. Exact Adobe numerical/model output and physical-input behavior remain unqualified.
Patch drag must stay within the canvas. Move/Extend output is limited to canvas coverage and requires some visible destination pixels.
Options are session state; complete Photoshop preference/preset persistence and every contextual variation remain open.
Live interaction, physical Intel and macOS14/26 runtime qualification remain open.
